scope: Ports the bounded selected AC1018 MLINE ASCII staged-output inspector and its source-model guards into a reviewable LibreCAD consumer patch. Adds a synchronous read-only verification callback to libdxfrw's atomic DXF writer so the consumer can validate the closed temporary before publication.

writerApi.ordering: Flush and close the private stage; call the read-only verifier; recheck staged-file, directory and destination identities; then atomically publish. Verifier refusal, exception, or identity change aborts publication.
writerApi.coverage: Fast unit controls cover verifier acceptance, refusal and exception; destination preservation; ASCII and Binary write refusal and corrected retry on the same codec; null-verifier refusal; and custom-class readback.

build.result: PASS; app and both focused test targets built against the current libdxfrw source overlay.

limitations: The staged scanner is ASCII-only and admits only the bounded selected AC1018 MLINE profile; it does not establish general MLINE or Binary MLINE support.
The consumer patch is an artifact for review and has not been applied to the shared LibreCAD checkout or merged upstream.
Headless build and focused selectors do not replace LibreCAD GUI save/reopen/render/edit qualification or LibreCAD_3 MPOLYGON qualification.
The remote ObjectARX host is known to be available, but its AutoCAD/ObjectARX release, exact OS/build and artifact return route remain unspecified; no producer witness is included.
No DWG/DXF fixture files were added to the repository. No support claim or package gate was promoted.
